svg.title: SSCS system context diagram
svg.desc: High-level map of SSCS systems. Appellants lodge appeals into CCD (the shared case system of record), fed by GHR/JHR judicial records. From CCD, Cardiff cases route to List Assist and the six other regions route to GAPS via a robot and nightly Caseloader sync. Judiciary set availability (self-service in List Assist for Cardiff, or via the allocation team for GAPS regions); allocation teams allocate sittings; venue clerks close sessions in GAPS. GAPS feeds Bristol Finance for payment and OPT/Power BI for reporting, while List Assist relies on local spreadsheets for actuals.

sendPrompt('What does the venue clerk do when closing a session in GAPS?')
sendPrompt('What is GHR/JHR and how does judicial ticketing affect allocation?')
sendPrompt('Explain CCD as the SSCS system of record, including managed cases and JCM.')
sendPrompt('How does List Assist work for Cardiff, and why is it planning-only?')
sendPrompt('What does GAPS do end-to-end for the six SSCS regions?')
sendPrompt('What manual spreadsheet work sits alongside List Assist and GAPS?')
sendPrompt('How are SSCS judiciary paid via Bristol Finance / JFEPS?')
sendPrompt('What reporting comes out of OPT and Power BI for SSCS?')
